mapper.select: SELECT id, name, age, sex, level_id, phone, type_id, hospital, account_id, createtime, updatetime FROM doctor WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO doctor (name, age, sex, level_id, phone, type_id, hospital, account_id, createtime, updatetime) VALUES (#{name}, #{age}, #{sex}, #{levelId}, #{phone}, #{typeId}, #{hospital}, #{accountId}, #{createtime}, #{updatetime})
mapper.update: UPDATE doctor SET name = #{name}, age = #{age}, sex = #{sex}, level_id = #{levelId}, phone = #{phone}, type_id = #{typeId}, hospital = #{hospital}, updatetime = #{updatetime} WHERE id = #{id}
